semantic_signal.honest_statement: BEHAVIOR does not label its models. The id is a random 6-letter token and upstream's own knowledge base exposes nothing but a bbox and a turntable video. Where the derived signals above do not vary inside a category, that category's model_discrimination says indistinguishable_by_indexed_signals: true -- those models are interchangeable to every consumer of this file. That is scoped to what is INDEXED, not to what is knowable: the colour pass under not_run_here would still separate some of them.

not_run_here.colour: diffuse-PNG mean decodes in stdlib zlib, ~18 min wall for 4058 models; NOT run
not_run_here.vlm_caption: local render + caption over the baked USDs is the ONLY route to true style semantics; NOT run. No field in this index carries appearance.

per_category: synset + full WordNet ancestor chain (482/482 resolve)
room + scene affinity from the 51 scene JSONs
LIVE builder capability: unit_models / graspable_models / receptacle_vocab
per_model_have: structure: link count, joint types, openable joints, glass tag (4058 of 4058)
meta-link sites: attachment / togglebutton / heatsource / particleapplier (580)
room + scene affinity (2506; the other 1552 baked models are never placed in any scene)
QA re-label note where a human wrote one (149)

vocab._absent_note: NOT indexed and NOT inferable offline: no BEHAVIOR file carries a name, description, colour, material or style for a model. Do not request one; the builder cannot honour it.
